I tidied up `0.html` while keeping it looking the same: a black 400px circle centred on the page. I haven't opened it in a browser to check.

- **No stray scrollbar:** removed `width: 100vw` from the body, which causes horizontal overflow whenever a vertical scrollbar is present.
- **Better mobile height:** replaced `height: 100vh` with `min-height: 100dvh` (with a `100vh` fallback), so the centring accounts for mobile browser toolbars and content can grow.
- **Scales on small screens:** the SVG is now `width: min(400px, 100vmin)` with automatic height, so it shrinks instead of being clipped on viewports under 400px.
- **Accessibility:** added `role="img"` and `aria-label="Circle"` so screen readers announce the graphic.
- **CSS reset:** added `box-sizing: border-box` and set the SVG to `display: block`.

I left the title and id as `ae683f770`, since they look like generated identifiers. The `aria-label` text is a placeholder of mine, so change it if the circle stands for something specific.

I did not add dark-mode support, because it would change how the page looks.

I made a handful of targeted fixes to `0.html`; the page was already in good shape, so I left the design alone. I haven't opened it in a browser to check the result.

## What changed

- **Clipping on hover:** the circle (radius 190 plus stroke) scaled by 1.05 grew past the 400-unit viewBox, and the bouncy easing overshoots further, so the edges were cut flat. The radius is now 180 and the SVG has `overflow: visible`.
- **Opacity snap:** only `transform` was transitioned, so the opacity jumped from 0.9 to 1. It now fades.
- **Hover target:** the effect fired on the whole SVG box, including the empty corners. It now fires only over the circle itself.
- **Touch feedback:** added `:active` so tapping gives the same response as hovering.
- **Reduced motion:** those users previously got no feedback at all. They now get the opacity change, without the scale.
- **Redundant stroke:** removed, since it was the same colour as the fill and only added to the radius.
- **Dark mode shadow:** raised from 0.3 to 0.6 alpha, as it was barely visible against the `#111` background.
- **Transform origin:** added `transform-box: fill-box` so the scale is centred on the circle itself.

## Left as is

The title and `aria-label` call this "animated" and "interactive", but the only motion is the hover effect. I didn't add an idle animation or reword the text, since either is a design call — say if you want one of them.

I rewrote `0.html` to fix several accessibility and behaviour problems, but it is untested in a browser: my headless Chrome screenshot attempt was blocked by the session's permissions.

## What was wrong and what changed

| Problem | Fix |
|---|---|
| The SVG was posing as a button (`role="button"`, `tabindex`, hand-written key handling). | It is now a real `<button>` with a decorative SVG inside, so keyboard and focus behaviour come from the browser. |
| `aria-pressed` flipped to true for 300 ms on each click, which wrongly marks it as a toggle button. | Removed. |
| The accessible name was a long instructional sentence, which also showed up as a tooltip. | The name is now "Change circle color". |
| Screen reader users were never told the colour had changed. | A visible `role="status"` label (Blue, Red, …) announces each change. |
| Clicking the empty corners of the square SVG changed the colour. | The button is circular, so the clickable area matches the shape. |
| The colour fade only ran for users with reduced motion, because a later rule overrode the transition. | The fade now applies for everyone; only the scaling is limited to users who allow motion. |
| The colours set from JS ignored dark mode, giving dark shades on a `#111` background. | The palette lives in CSS with a lighter dark-mode variant for each colour; JS only sets `data-color`. |
| The hint text was coloured at 0.7 opacity, which fell below 4.5:1 contrast. | The hint uses a neutral text colour at full opacity. |
| `will-change` was permanently set on the circle. | Removed. |

## Changes you might not expect

- **Press feedback:** the circle now shrinks slightly while pressed.
- **Touch tweaks:** I added `touch-action: manipulation` and removed the tap highlight.
- **Hint wording:** the hint now mentions tapping as well as clicking.
- **Colour label:** the colour name is new visible text under the circle.

The circle is still 360px across at full size.

I made a few small fixes to `0.html`. The page was already in good shape (responsive, dark mode, reduced motion and high-contrast support, keyboard focus styles), so I didn't restructure anything. I haven't tested these changes in a browser yet.

1. **The color fade probably didn't work.** The circle's fill uses `currentColor`, and browsers generally won't animate a fill set that way when the underlying color changes, so it most likely just jumped to the new color. I moved the transition to the button's `color`, which is the value that actually changes. That should make the 0.4s fade work.
2. **Screen readers now read the current color and instructions.** When the button gets focus, it now reads out the current color and the hint text, so screen reader users hear more than just "Change circle color."
3. **Clearer wording.** The hint now says "Enter or Space" instead of "Enter/Space", which reads better aloud.

Made two improvements to `0.html`:

1. **Forced-colors (Windows High Contrast) support** – added a stroke to the SVG circle so it remains visible instead of disappearing when `currentColor` gets overridden in forced-colors mode.
2. **Persisted color choice** – the selected color now saves to `localStorage` and restores on page reload, so refreshing doesn't reset the demo back to blue.
